question: Among drivers who have never finished a race (i.e., have no recorded finish time), identify the top 10 with the fastest personal best lap times across all races. Return their full names and nationality.

prediction.sql:
WITH never_finished AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034
    FROM drivers AS d
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM results AS r
        WHERE r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
          AND r.XCL_084 IS NOT NULL
    )
),
best_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        MIN(lt.XCL_048) AS best_lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY lt.XCL_044
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality
FROM best_laps AS bl
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = bl.driver_id
INNER JOIN never_finished AS nf ON nf.XCL_034 = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY bl.best_lap_ms ASC
LIMIT 10
